tcp 5432  postgres in container db (postgres:16)
Reachable from the internet. ufw does not allow it.

gets through  anyone (192.0.2.7) -> 203.0.113.10
              anyone on the local network (203.0.113.11) -> 203.0.113.10
  A rule in chain DOCKER of table nat sends it on to 172.18.0.2:5432, container db. From there it is
  forwarded, not delivered to this machine, so the INPUT chain, where ufw keeps its list, never
  sees it.

  1  prerouting  nat PREROUTING         to chain DOCKER
                 -A PREROUTING -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
> 2  prerouting  nat DOCKER             destination becomes 172.18.0.2:5432
                 -A DOCKER ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 5432 -j DNAT
                   --to-destination 172.18.0.2:5432
  3  route                              forwarded: 172.18.0.2 is reached through br-4c2f9a71d0e3
  4  forward     filter FORWARD         to chain DOCKER-FORWARD
                 -A FORWARD -j DOCKER-FORWARD
  5  forward     filter DOCKER-FORWARD  to chain DOCKER-BRIDGE
                 -A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-BRIDGE
  6  forward     filter DOCKER-BRIDGE   to chain DOCKER
                 -A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -j DOCKER
  7  forward     filter DOCKER          accept
                 -A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.2/32 ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -o br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp
                   --dport 5432 -j ACCEPT
> 8  deliver     handed to container db, where postgres is listening on port 5432

dropped       anyone (2001:db8:99::7) -> 2001:db8:1::10
              anyone on the local network (2001:db8:1::11) -> 2001:db8:1::10
  No rule lets it in: chain INPUT ends with policy drop.

  1  route                    for this machine: 2001:db8:1::10 is one of its own addresses
> 2  input  ip6 filter INPUT  policy drop: no rule let it through
